latest_final: A picked up a pencil with an eraser attached, but its graphite tip was broken or missing. They used a separate piece of graphite to make the message by rubbing or scraping it under pressure across the blank paper. The pencil did not write the message itself: it indirectly supported an object that helped guide or control the separate graphite during that process. The eraser was incidental to the writing; nothing was being erased.
